claims.quote: A postal packet's dip-dial records every yard of every run. The tapes then go to the A. B. C., which collates and makes composite photographs of them for the instruction of captains.
claims.description: Airships carry automatic flight recorders that log every yard of a trip, with the data collated centrally for pilot training.

claims.quote: She is responsible only to the Aerial Board of Control the A. B. C. of which Tim speaks so flippantly. But that semi-elected, semi-nominated body of a few score of persons of both sexes, controls this planet.
claims.description: A single global aerial transport authority governs the whole planet, with national governments largely replaced.

claims.quote: “Transportation is Civilisation,” our motto runs. Theoretically, we do what we please so long as we do not interfere with the traffic AND ALL IT IMPLIES.
claims.description: Society is organized around global air traffic, with personal freedom permitted so long as traffic is not hindered.

claims.quote: Her black hull, double conning-tower, and ever-ready slings represent all that remains to the planet of that odd old word authority.
claims.description: Airborne Mark Boats act as stationary air-sea rescue stations, salvage tugs and weather bureaus policing the aerial routes.

claims.quote: And minute by minute our silent clock gives us a sixteen-second mile.
claims.description: Passenger and mail airships cruise at roughly 225 mph, crossing the Atlantic in about ten to twelve hours.

claims.quote: Just you wait a few years, my shining friend, and we'll take steps that will amaze you. We'll Joshua you!
claims.description: Aircraft will eventually be fast enough to stop or hold the sun in place relative to the traveller, extending daylight at will.

claims.quote: But some day—even on the Equator—we shall hold the Sun level in his full stride.
claims.description: Air travel will someday be fast enough to keep pace with the sun even at the equator.

claims.quote: The deep-sea freighters are rising to lung up after the long night
claims.description: Large submersible cargo ships routinely travel deep underwater and surface periodically to renew air.

claims.quote: We could see the doctors and the nurses and the white-button-like faces of the cot-patients.
claims.description: Airborne hospital ships carry consumptives and accident patients, flying them to northern or glacier sanatoriums for treatment.

claims.quote: We hoist 'em in sterilized air for a while. Same idea. How much do the doctors say we've added to the average life of man?”
claims.description: Medical advances have substantially lengthened average human lifespan.

claims.quote: “Thirty years,” says George with a twinkle in his eye.
claims.description: Medicine has added thirty years to average human life expectancy.

claims.quote: Trans-Asiatic Directs we met, soberly ringing the world round the Fiftieth Meridian at an honest seventy knots
claims.description: Scheduled airship services circle the globe along fixed routes at about seventy knots.

claims.quote: Yellow-bellied ore-flats and Ungava petrol-tanks punted down leisurely out of the north, like strings of unfrightened wild duck.
claims.description: Bulk cargoes such as ore, oil and grain are carried by large freight airships.

claims.quote: white-painted Ackroyd & Hunt fruiters out of the south fled beneath us, their ventilated hulls whistling like Chinese kites.
claims.description: Fresh tropical fruit and beef are flown or shipped swiftly in bulk to northern health sanatoria.

claims.quote: Last summer the islanders grew wearied, as their premier explained, of “playing at being savages for pennies,” and proceeded to pull down all the landing-towers on the island
claims.description: Crete, the last holdout of local self-government, is taken over by the global aerial board, leaving no autonomous institutions in Europe.

claims.quote: the large, prosperous, and presumably public-spirited communities which during the last few years have deliberately thrown themselves into the hands of the A. B. C.
claims.description: Communities voluntarily surrender public administration to a central authority because people prefer not to govern themselves.

claims.quote: Messages and wills of crew at all A. B. C. offices.
claims.description: A global system of lights, fog signals and radio-type general calls guides and tracks aircraft, posting overdue craft as missing.

claims.quote: But bat-boat racing has a great future before it.
claims.description: Racing hybrid boat-planes (bat boats) become a popular competitive sport with regulated designs.

claims.quote: Racing planes and digs alike have suffered severely—the former from unequal deposits of half-frozen slush on their vans
claims.description: Personal racing aeroplanes and small airships are common recreational vehicles that suffer from high-level sleet.
